moments.quote: “Sex sells, fellas,” he said about Jensen Huang’s scandal—said it could be a net positive

moments.author: Markwayne Mullin
moments.quote: We are DELIGHTED to announce that Kilmar Abrego Garcia has self‑deported from the United States to Spain
moments.why: That blunt DHS statement turned a decades-long debate on immigration and legal drama into a simplified viral moment, resonating among men in politics.

moments.author: Kilmar Abrego Garcia’s lawyer / family (reported)

moments.why: This closure for a high-profile immigration saga saw massive male interest around legal fights, due process, and Trump-era policy.
